arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-route.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = c7996a41c22d99f52f25d4c12e793bb3b3a8917d
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,re
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
needles=('owner_coordinator_ingress','CODEx_CLOUD_COORDINATOR_SUBMITTED','submit_owner_order(','/VPS/issues','independent VPS Coordinator')
hits=[]
for name in tracked:
 if name.startswith(('.project-leader/','codex/tests/')):continue
 p=Path(name)
 if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size>200000 or p.suffix not in ('.py','.md','.sh','.yml','.yaml','.toml','.json'):continue
 text=p.read_text(errors='replace')
 for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
  if any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in needles):
   hits.append((name,i,line[:175]))
print('LEGACY_REFERENCE_COUNT',len(hits),flush=True)
for name,lineno,line in hits[:45]:print('REF',name,lineno,line,flush=True)
print('PROJECT_COORDINATOR_RUNTIME',Path('codex/smart.py').exists(),Path('codex/agent_policy.py').exists())
PY
python3 -m unittest codex.tests.test_cloud_bridge codex.tests.test_coordination_contract codex.tests.test_owner_coordinator_ingress -q
echo CLOUD_BRIDGE_COORDINATION_AND_LEGACY_TESTS_PASS
python3 -m unittest discover -s codex/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q
echo ALL_CODEX_OFFLINE_TESTS_PASS
if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo CODEX_CLI_AVAILABLE; else echo CODEX_CLI_UNAVAILABLE_ON_REA_HOST; fi
echo ROUTING_INSPECTION_COMPLETE
